metadata.name: Outlook Account Generator
metadata.description: Creates Outlook/Hotmail accounts on the profile's own browser engine (proxy + fingerprint + human input, to pass Microsoft's Arkose signals). A generator, not an entry tool: it mints its own human-looking usernames (first+last+random digits) - no email list needed. Uses the current create-account surface (outlook.live.com/mail/?prompt=create_account, fluent=2): email + domain dropdown -> password -> country/birthdate (Fluent dropdowns) -> first/last name -> FunCaptcha (Arkose) solve. Captures the Arkose data[blob] in-page, gets the token from the configured solver, and submits it through the challenge-complete postMessage so the cross-origin enforcement frame is never a problem. Fails fast on taken emails, SMS gates, and flagged exit IPs. Optionally fills a backup email, saves to the Database, and opens the inbox once to warm the account. Needs a captcha key in Key Vault; proxies recommended. Outlook gen.

inputs.label: Mint @hotmail.com instead of outlook.*
inputs.hint: Off: prefer @outlook.com (the surface offers a short list like @outlook.com / @outlook.in / @hotmail.com; falls back to what's offered). On: prefer @hotmail.com.

inputs.label: Backup email (optional)
inputs.hint: Filled on the backup/verify-email page when Microsoft asks for one. Leave empty to skip that page.

inputs.label: Open inbox after generation
inputs.hint: Open the mailbox once after the account is created to warm the session.

inputs.hint: A generator: it mints its own human-looking username and rotates the offered outlook.*/hotmail.com domains - no email list or profile batching. Each run creates one account and saves it to the Database. Run N threads for N accounts.
